decision: Ownership merge: repo+luca_version always refreshed by luca; environment/ls_message_format fill only when absent; all other pre-existing user keys in CC_LANGSMITH_METADATA preserved verbatim
alternatives: spread existing keys last so ALL user keys win (breaks luca_version refresh on re-init); full clobber (violates spec)
reasoning: mirrors install-statusline ownership pattern — refresh luca-owned fields, preserve user fields; keeps re-init idempotent while user custom keys survive
risk: user who deliberately pinned repo/luca_version gets it refreshed

decision: TRACE_TO_LANGSMITH detection reads env block of global ~/.claude/settings.json (defaultClaudeHome()) with process.env.TRACE_TO_LANGSMITH fallback; 'true' gates the step
alternatives: process.env only (misses settings.json when init not run under Claude Code); project settings only
reasoning: verified live config: langsmith-tracing plugin writes env.TRACE_TO_LANGSMITH into ~/.claude/settings.json; init runs outside Claude Code so process.env alone unreliable

decision: Weekly-cadence runbook lives at docs/guides/trace-insights-cadence.md; trace-insights skill files untouched — keeps anti-criterion simple; /schedule creation is documented post-merge operator step, not in-repo code
alternatives: runbook in skill body Notes (forces skill file change
reasoning: spec explicitly offers the choice and prefers docs/; docs/guides/ exists
risk: skill users may not discover the guide

decision: Repo name = basename of git rev-parse --show-toplevel, falling back to basename(cwd); helper accepts injected repoName for tests
reasoning: spec binds git-root basename; cwd fallback covers non-git dirs; injection keeps merge fn pure/testable
risk: worktree/submodule basename may differ from expected repo name

decision: Fixed pre-existing process.exitCode restore bug in telemetry.test.ts (one line) to unblock ac-09
reasoning: ac-09 (full luca-cli suite exits 0) is a phase gate; baseline stash run proved exit 1 pre-exists my changes; Bun 1.3.11 keeps exitCode=1 when assigned undefined, so the test's restore was a no-op. One-line fix restores the gate; anti-criteria untouched.
risk: File outside the plan's declared scope list; reviewer may flag the extra hunk
reviewHint: Verify the exitCode restore fix is isolated to the finally block
